llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it is an instruction-only curl-based wrapper for the mkts.io market-data API, requests no unusual credentials, and has no install steps or code that would expand its footprint.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the instructions: SKILL.md documents HTTP endpoints for market data and shows curl examples. Required binary is only curl, which is appropriate for an HTTP-based, instruction-only skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to calling mkts.io endpoints (including an optional registration POST). They do not instruct reading local files, other env vars, or contacting unexpected endpoints. The optional registration step asks the user to POST an email/name to mkts.io — that's expected behavior for obtaining an API key.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files are present, so nothing will be written to disk or installed. This is the lowest-risk model for a skill of this type.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables or credentials; MKTS_API_KEY is listed as optional and its use is justified (higher rate limits). There are no unrelated credentials or config paths requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system presence or modify other skills. It only instructs network calls to mkts.io.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only wrapper for mkts.io and appears coherent. Before installing: verify mkts.io is a service you trust, and avoid sharing sensitive credentials in plain environments. If you register for an API key, treat it like any API secret (store securely, do not paste into public chat). Be aware the agent will make outbound network calls to mkts.io (and may transmit the optional MKTS_API_KEY in an HTTP header) — if your environment restricts external network access, consider that. If you need stronger assurance, confirm the mkts.io domain and privacy/terms and test requests manually with curl first.
